# Configuration reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py; do not edit by hand -->

Configs are YAML files with five sections (`model`, `data`, `optim`, `train`, and nested
`optim.scheduler`, `train.eval`, `data.sources`). A file may `extends:` another (relative path, deep-merged),
and any value can be overridden on the command line with `section.key=value`, e.g.
`python scripts/train.py --config configs/train/pretrain-16gb.yaml train.micro_batch_size=2`.
Unknown keys are rejected with a suggestion.

## `model`

Architecture of the transformer. `head_dim: 0` means `d_model // n_heads`; `act_ckpt` trades compute for activation memory (`none` | `selective` | `sac` | `full`).

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `vocab_size` | `int` | `32768` |
| `d_model` | `int` | `1280` |
| `n_layers` | `int` | `28` |
| `n_heads` | `int` | `20` |
| `n_kv_heads` | `int` | `5` |
| `head_dim` | `int` | `0` |
| `mlp_hidden` | `int` | `3456` |
| `max_seq_len` | `int` | `2048` |
| `rope_theta` | `float` | `500000.0` |
| `norm_eps` | `float` | `1e-06` |
| `qk_norm` | `bool` | `True` |
| `tie_embeddings` | `bool` | `True` |
| `init_std` | `float` | `0.02` |
| `init_seed` | `int` | `1337` |
| `attn_impl` | `str` | `'sdpa'` |
| `act_ckpt` | `str` | `'none'` |
| `act_ckpt_every` | `int` | `1` |

## `data`

Where tokens come from and how they are batched. `sources` are prepared datasets mixed by weight.

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `sources` | `list[SourceConfig]` | `[]` |
| `sft_path` | `str` | `''` |
| `tokenizer_path` | `str` | `'data/tokenizer/snapdragon-32k.json'` |
| `seq_len` | `int` | `2048` |
| `doc_masking` | `bool` | `False` |
| `prefetch_batches` | `int` | `4` |
| `pin_memory` | `bool` | `True` |
| `val_tokens` | `int` | `10000000` |
| `seed` | `int` | `1337` |

## `data.sources`

One tokenized dataset in the mixture.

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `(required)` |
| `path` | `str` | `(required)` |
| `weight` | `float` | `1.0` |

## `optim`

Muon trains hidden matrices, (8-bit) AdamW trains embeddings and gains.

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `muon_lr` | `float` | `0.02` |
| `muon_momentum` | `float` | `0.95` |
| `muon_weight_decay` | `float` | `0.01` |
| `adam_lr` | `float` | `0.0006` |
| `adam_betas` | `tuple[float, float]` | `(0.9, 0.95)` |
| `adam_eps` | `float` | `1e-08` |
| `adam_weight_decay` | `float` | `0.1` |
| `eight_bit` | `bool` | `True` |
| `offload_states` | `bool` | `False` |
| `grad_clip` | `float` | `1.0` |
| `scheduler` | `SchedulerConfig` | `SchedulerConfig()` |

## `optim.scheduler`

Learning-rate schedule: `wsd` (warmup-stable-decay, stoppable anywhere), `cosine` or `linear`.

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `str` | `'wsd'` |
| `warmup_steps` | `int` | `500` |
| `decay_fraction` | `float` | `0.2` |
| `min_lr_ratio` | `float` | `0.1` |

## `train`

The training loop: batch layout, precision, curriculum, checkpointing, resume.

|---|---|---|
| `run_name` | `str` | `'snapdragon-500m'` |
| `out_dir` | `str` | `'runs'` |
| `seed` | `int` | `1337` |
| `global_batch_tokens` | `int` | `524288` |
| `micro_batch_size` | `int` | `4` |
| `seq_len` | `int` | `2048` |
| `max_tokens` | `int` | `10000000000` |
| `precision` | `str` | `'bf16'` |
| `compile` | `str` | `'auto'` |
| `seq_len_start` | `int` | `512` |
| `seq_len_warmup_tokens` | `int` | `0` |
| `log_every` | `int` | `10` |
| `save_every` | `int` | `500` |
| `keep_last_n` | `int` | `3` |
| `resume` | `str` | `'auto'` |
| `ema_decay` | `float` | `0.0` |
| `task` | `str` | `'pretrain'` |
| `init_from` | `str` | `''` |
| `parallel` | `str` | `'ddp'` |
| `loss_spike_factor` | `float` | `0.0` |

| `ce_chunk_tokens` | `int` | `2048` |
| `eval` | `EvalConfig` | `EvalConfig()` |

## `train.eval`

Validation loss and benchmark cadence during training.

| key | type | default |
|---|---|---|
| `tasks` | `list[str]` | `['hellaswag']` |
| `every_steps` | `int` | `1000` |
| `benchmark_every` | `int` | `0` |
| `limit` | `int` | `0` |
| `val_batches` | `int` | `20` |
